title: Capture golden state
summary: Capture a new golden through the governed operation to seal current cause-bearing probes. On macOS it first asks a running Safari to quit and waits for it, never force-quitting, so Safari's state is on disk; Linux and WSL capture does the same for the desktop Chromium, refusing test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved when it stays open; macOS harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store stay outside the archive. Saving a completed harness sign-in is this same capture. Required Linux teaching also excludes desktop Chromium sign-ins from every golden and preserves the existing ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium store only when present after Chromium quits; an older golden must never restore stale browser sign-in state. Reset correction 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e implements snap-store exclusion and conditional carry-forward and is now included in merged source 9768e3e8e225ed4120d2251eac4587ea6aa4ddd0. Earlier producer evidence was 29 targeted PASS, CI run 39040788218 PASS and QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759. Final source 6fd8127f13e7e3fa3779d9d3ca7647881dac46d7 passed full CI run 39045367272, QA requirement 50674 artifact 36808, after one authorized unchanged-index-flake rerun with original failure retained. Merged source and CI do not prove delivered or real reset/sign-in behavior; that proof remains pending. Observed status covers source observations, not live verification. Capture refuses golden_capture_insufficient_space before writing when the destination filesystem cannot hold the home, and after the new golden is registered it deletes every retired snapshot except that golden, any golden another project registered for the same machine (named by the server as kept_golden_paths), and their probes, manifests and harness CLI version records (GOLDEN.harness-clis); when the server cannot name those goldens it deletes nothing and refuses golden_snapshot_retention_failed. Capture writes the version record from each harness CLI's --version as the test user and repeats it on the receipt as harness_cli_versions; an unreadable version refuses golden_harness_cli_version_unreadable. An undeclared nonzero probe exit retries once with both attempts retained; a declared failure stops immediately.
